name: Booboo Stewart
biography: Nils Allen "Booboo" Stewart Jr. (born January 21, 1994) is an American actor, musician, and visual artist. He is known for playing Seth Clearwater in The Twilight Saga; Warpath in X-Men: Days of Future Past; and Jay in the Disney television film franchise Descendants.
